opportunities.name: AP tumble packet
opportunities.objective: Investigate Q AP damage in an actual Spellblade attack while preserving Silver Bolts cadence.
opportunities.mechanic: Q next attack adds 0.5 AP but deals physical damage; Lich Bane and Nashor add separate magic attack packets. R reduces Tumble cooldown and grants one second invisibility on Q, buying a spacing window. Rageblade can be tested for Silver Bolts delivery rather than presumed to copy the third-hit counter.
opportunities.requiredState: Same target for consecutive W actions; finite Rageblade ramp and R active.
opportunities.failure: Low AD and attack commitment can lose damage before the next Silver Bolts trigger.
opportunities.test: Separate physical Q, magic item packets and true W at matched consecutive attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic penetration does not improve Q physical damage or W true damage.

opportunities.name: Condemn frost pocket
opportunities.objective: Use Q Spellblade slowing to hold a wall angle for Condemn and three real hits.
opportunities.mechanic: Iceborn rewards the actual post-Tumble attack with a frost field; E only gains its extra damage and stun when the target hits terrain. BotRK adds a current-health physical on-hit and three-attack slow, while Terminus supplies finite mixed penetration/resistance stacks. R/Night Hunter improve pursuit after the controlled pocket.
opportunities.requiredState: A real wall behind the target and same-target attack access; item stacks start recorded.
opportunities.failure: The frost field cannot create terrain or rescue a failed E angle; armor spending lowers carry output.
opportunities.test: Record E wall success and time to three same-target attacks versus a moving opponent.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Iceborn slows do not make every Condemn a wall stun.

ruledOut.reason: W requires three consecutive actions against an enemy; the source does not establish independent Silver Bolts counters on bolts.

unknowns: Q spell-effects helper remains unresolved; Rageblade/Dusk on-hit effects versus W counters require live validation.

builds.name: AP tumble packet
builds.summary: Investigate Q AP damage in an actual Spellblade attack while preserving Silver Bolts cadence.
builds.goal: Investigate Q AP damage in an actual Spellblade attack while preserving Silver Bolts cadence.
builds.hypothesis: Q next attack adds 0.5 AP but deals physical damage; Lich Bane and Nashor add separate magic attack packets. R reduces Tumble cooldown and grants one second invisibility on Q, buying a spacing window. Rageblade can be tested for Silver Bolts delivery rather than presumed to copy the third-hit counter.
testPlan: Required state: Same target for consecutive W actions; finite Rageblade ramp and R active.
Separate physical Q, magic item packets and true W at matched consecutive attacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD and attack commitment can lose damage before the next Silver Bolts trigger.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Magic penetration does not improve Q physical damage or W true damage.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
